runtime: R base and stats native leaves (.Internal / .Primitive / .External / .Call, implemented in C); every R-level function (lapply, Reduce, do.call, tryCatch, ...) is R code and derived, composing with these leaves
conventions: Symbols are the native spelling as written in R source: .Internal(name) (positions are the inner call's arguments: .Internal(lapply(X, FUN)) -> FUN is pos 1), .Primitive("name"), .External2(C_sym) / .External(C_sym) (positions are the outer call's arguments, pos 0 is the native symbol).

entries.describe: .Internal(lapply(X, FUN)) calls FUN on every element (vapply, rapply and eapply alike)
entries.why: C implementation behind lapply/sapply/vapply/rapply/eapply: no R source

entries.describe: .Internal(mapply(FUN, dots, MoreArgs)) calls FUN on the parallel elements (mapply, Map)
entries.why: C implementation behind mapply/Map: no R source

entries.describe: .Internal(do.call(what, args, envir)) calls what (a function or a function name) with args
entries.why: C implementation behind do.call: no R source

entries.describe: .Internal(reg.finalizer(e, f, onexit)) calls f when e is collected
entries.why: C implementation behind reg.finalizer: no R source

entries.describe: .Internal(makeActiveBinding(sym, fun, env)) calls fun on every access of the binding
entries.why: C implementation behind makeActiveBinding: no R source

entries.describe: .Internal(.addCondHands(classes, handlers, ...)) installs condition handlers that run when a matching condition is signalled (tryCatch, withCallingHandlers)
entries.why: C implementation of the condition system: no R source

entries.describe: on.exit(expr) evaluates expr when the calling function exits
.External2(C_optim, par, fn, gr, ...) calls fn and gr repeatedly (optim)
entries.why: C implementation in the stats package: no R source

entries.describe: the optimisers/root finders/integrators call their function argument repeatedly (optimize, uniroot, nlm, integrate)
entries.why: C implementation in the stats package: no R source

io_send.describe: .Internal(system(command, ...)) runs a shell command line (system and system2 derive down to it)
.Internal(url(description, ...)) opens a URL connection (url() and readLines(url) derive down to it)

ffi_conventions.describe: .Call(name, ...) calls a registered or exported C routine by name
.C(name, ...) calls a C routine by name
.External(name, ...) calls a C routine by name

test_conventions.describe: testthat runs tests/testthat/test*.R files; test_that() bodies are run by the runner
